title: Search multiple locations for target objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of an object and the first location does not contain all needed items.
content: When collecting multiple objects, check various plausible surfaces and containers rather than expecting all instances in one place. If a location appears empty or lacks the target, move on to other nearby locations and inspect them.

description: Use when a take action fails with "Nothing happens" even though the object is visible in the environment.
content: A failed pick-up attempt may be transient; re-examine the location or object, check inventory, and retry the take action. Sometimes moving away and returning to the location can reset the interaction and allow the pick-up to succeed.

content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens" multiple times, the object may not actually be reachable or the agent may already be holding an item. Check your inventory and re-examine the location to confirm what is actually available before retrying the same action.

content: In ALFWorld, actions sometimes fail silently with "Nothing happens" even when the command is valid. Repeating the same action can eventually succeed, so do not abandon a valid action after a single failed attempt.
